data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We understand your frustration with the search functionality. Please try searching using exact phrases in quotes, and if that fails, log out and back into the web app to trigger a re-indexing of your account. If the SEARCH-002 error persists, please send us specific search terms and the files you expect to see so we can investigate further. [T-4810] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
